description: Institutional-grade programmable-rights harness. Ordering authority. Critical path: T0 -> (T1,T2) -> (T4,T5,T6) -> T9 -> future modules. Every task runs the 5-phase loop in verification_rules.md.

gates.blocked-until-foundation: Requires T4, T5, T6 all 'done' AND T9 'done' before it may start. Enforces: no new modules before the module contract, right-type taxonomy, and unified redemption exist and are proven on loyalty.
